CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  August 25, 2026

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:04 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Michael Daninger; Stanley Tsai, Jennifer Ng

  Absent:  Nora Corona, Chairman; Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect; Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – August 11, 2026
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the August 11, 2026, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the August 11, 2026, Regular Meeting of
  the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve all Consent Agenda Items.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-0-0-2
  Ayes:  Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Corona, Udani

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-26-002
  • 1 West Bay State Street
  • Applicant: Kasey Clark
  • Request: This is an application for the installation of new signage on
  an existing commercial building for a business known as “Citibank.”
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.
  1
  08/25/2026
 MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Provide the dimensional height of all proposed signage
  lettering for each sign. The revised signage package shall be
  resubmitted to City staff for review and approval.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-0-0-2
  Ayes:  Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Corona, Udani

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-26-067
  • 3120 West Main Street
  • Applicant: Shawn Zuo and Vivian Wang
  • Request: This is an application for a new trash enclosure located
  within a new planter area in an existing commercial parking lot to be
  restriped.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.
MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Revise the proposed trash enclosure roof to provide a
  minimum roof slope of 2:12. The revised design shall be
  resubmitted to City staff for review and approval.

  •  Moved by Board Member Tsai, Seconded by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-0-0-2
  Ayes:  Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Corona, Udani

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-26-047
  • 3216 Concord Avenue
  • Applicant: Scott Doughman and Alfonso Paredes
  • Request: This is an application for the replacement of various
  existing windows at an existing single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

  2
  08/25/2026
 MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-0-0-2
  Ayes:  Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Corona, Udani

AGENDA
ITEM 5:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-26-033
  • 517 South Chapel Avenue
  • Applicant: Giselle Reyna
  • Request: This is an application for exterior alterations to an existing
  single-family residence, including modifications to exterior wall
  cladding, replacement of windows, installation of new gable attic
  vents, and updates to the exterior color palette.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved with the following Conditions of Approval:
  1. Clarify the proposed color of the existing wood fascia and
  ensure the callouts are consistent across all elevation
  drawings and plan sheets.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to continue the application with the following considerations:
  1. Revise the proposed color of the existing wood fascia to
  “black” and update all applicable notes and callouts
  accordingly to reflect the approved color.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-0-0-2
  Ayes:  Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Corona, Udani
AGENDA
ITEM 6:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-26-005
  • 1700 South Ninth Street
  • Applicant: Sarina Truong
  • Request: This is an application for the construction of a new 3,209
  SF 2-story duplex at the rear of an existing multi-family residential
  property, a new 156 SF 1-story addition to the existing single-family
  residence, and associated site improvements.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

  3
  08/25/2026
   MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-0-0-2
  Ayes:  Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Corona, Udani

E.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

F.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:39 P.M. to
  Tuesday, September 8, 2026, at 7:00 P.M.

  _____________________________
  Nora Corona
  Chairman
ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
